source_title: Patreon Paid Podcasters 629 Million In 2025 As Direct To Fan Model Accelerates
snippet_primary: "Patreon says more than 47,000 podcasters are now active on Patreon, supported by 7.6 million paid memberships — up from roughly 40,000 creators in 2023. It means podcasts are now the largest content category on the platform."
subject_exact: InsideAudioMarketing citing Patreon (April 2026): 47,000+ active podcasters with 7.6M paid memberships, up from ~40,000 in 2023; podcasts now Patreon's largest content category

local_qualifiers: podcasts now largest content category on Patreon; up from ~40k creators in 2023
